_comment: Golden fixture for the AWS config slice — input host-agent config YAML (block-style only, the yaml_lite subset) -> per-(server,shed) Resolve() results + Enabled() verdict + the applied load defaults (source_profile/session_duration/cache_refresh_before). Read by BOTH the Go runner (cmd/shed-host-agent/golden_test.go:TestGoldenAWSResolve, via the production LoadConfig->AWS.Resolve/Enabled path) and the Rust runner (crates/shed-host-agent/src/config.rs tests::golden_aws_resolve, via HostAgentConfig::parse().aws) so the two impls cannot drift together on the layering / mode-normalization / enabled / load-defaults semantics. Mirrors TestAWSResolve / TestMixedModeResolve / TestAWSEnabled / TestLoadConfigAWS / TestLoadConfigDefaults.

vectors.name: top-level only; defaults applied when keys absent; session_duration falls back to top-level default
per-server role override; defaults overridden by explicit keys; same shed name on other server isolated
vectors.config_yaml:
aws:
  source_profile: staging
  default_role: arn:aws:iam::123:role/default
  session_duration: 2h
  cache_refresh_before: 10m
  servers:
    mini2:
      default_role: arn:aws:iam::123:role/mini2

vectors.name: per-server + per-shed session_duration layering (shed wins over server wins over top-level default)
vectors.config_yaml:
aws:
  default_role: arn:aws:iam::123:role/default
  servers:
    mini2:
      session_duration: 3h
      sheds:
        web:
          role: arn:aws:iam::123:role/web
          session_duration: 30m
        api:
          role: arn:aws:iam::123:role/api

vectors.name: mixed passthrough/assume-role per shed; role present under passthrough is ignored for mode
vectors.config_yaml:
aws:
  default_role: arn:aws:iam::111:role/dev
  servers:
    mini2:
      sheds:
        sso-app:
          mode: passthrough
        scoped-app:
          role: arn:aws:iam::111:role/scoped

vectors.name: empty-mode inheritance: child role under passthrough parent stays passthrough
vectors.config_yaml:
aws:
  servers:
    mini2:
      mode: passthrough
      sheds:
        web:
          role: arn:aws:iam::123:role/web

vectors.name: child assume-role overrides passthrough parent; sibling with no override inherits passthrough
vectors.config_yaml:
aws:
  mode: passthrough
  servers:
    mini2:
      sheds:
        scoped:
          mode: assume-role
          role: arn:aws:iam::123:role/scoped

vectors.name: enabled-false: explicit assume-role with no role anywhere is AWS off
no aws block at all: defaults applied, empty mode normalizes to assume-role, disabled
